name: Notion
tagline: Answers team questions from your Notion workspace and cites the pages it used
description: Treats a team's Notion workspace as its source of truth: ask a question and it answers from the pages that exist, pointing at the page behind each claim. Where it spots a gap it drafts the missing update for you to place. No write happens on its own; publishing, moving, archiving or removing a page all need your OK.
author: scottxmetcalf
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
